title: The pandemic brought world life expectancy its deepest fall since 1960
subtitle: Portrait story, 1080 × 1920 px: five numbered sections, a line chart of the world and its regions, a choropleth map, a fall-and-recovery bar chart, a unit chart of 236 countries and eight small multiples
data: UN World Population Prospects (2024), Human Mortality Database (2024), Zijdeman and Ribeira da Silva (2015), Riley (2005); processed by Our World in Data, downloaded 2026-10-12; CC BY 4.0. Natural Earth v5.1.2 (outlines, UN regions, population estimates), public domain
alt: World life expectancy fell 1.7 years in 2020–21, from 72.6 to 70.9 years, the deepest fall since 1960; by 2023 it reached a record 73.2 years.
note: One story, three formats: every number is computed from the data files by the script, nothing typed.

title: World life expectancy fell 1.7 years in the pandemic, then rose to a record 73.2
subtitle: Social square, 1080 × 1080 px: the world line inside the spread of all countries, three stat tiles, a mini map and the deepest falls
data: UN World Population Prospects (2024), Human Mortality Database (2024), Zijdeman and Ribeira da Silva (2015), Riley (2005); processed by Our World in Data, downloaded 2026-10-12; CC BY 4.0. Natural Earth v5.1.2 (outlines, UN regions, population estimates), public domain
alt: World life expectancy fell 1.7 years in 2020–21, from 72.6 to 70.9 years, the deepest fall since 1960; by 2023 it reached a record 73.2 years. 90 % of 236 countries and territories were at or above their 2019 level in 2023.
note: One story, three formats: every number is computed from the data files by the script, nothing typed.

title: Countries have drawn together: the middle 80 % spanned 30 years of life expectancy in 1950, 19 in 2023
subtitle: Landscape data sheet, 1920 × 1080 px: a beeswarm of every mapped country by decade, a bubble chart of the pandemic fall and the narrowing spread
data: UN World Population Prospects (2024), Human Mortality Database (2024), Zijdeman and Ribeira da Silva (2015), Riley (2005); processed by Our World in Data, downloaded 2026-10-12; CC BY 4.0. Natural Earth v5.1.2 (outlines, UN regions, population estimates), public domain
alt: Beeswarm of 172 countries' life expectancy every decade from 1950 to 2023: the median rose from 49.2 to 75.3 years and the middle 80 % narrowed from 30.4 to 18.9 years. A bubble chart shows the pandemic fall against life expectancy in 2019.
note: One story, three formats: every number is computed from the data files by the script, nothing typed.
